scope: Independent read-only geometric validation and visual review of the completed train-car interior.
result: Geometry-completion checks: PASS. Precise source fitting: NOT ACHIEVED.
unit_convention: Inferred model units, not measured metres.

enclosure_junctions.includes: Dense floor/sidewall and roof/sidewall seams, sloped-roof end-wall corners, and side-window edges. Furniture and curtains do not mask this enclosure test.

furniture_supports.method: Cross-sectional support rays plus common-axis, non-positive-gap bounds from floor plates/feet through pedestal/plinth to furniture.

glb_reimports.topology_note: GLB preserves split UV/normal vertices. Split-vertex boundary counts and artifacts from diagnostic welding are not enclosed-shell defects. Raw imported triangles are nondegenerate; saved BLEND component topology is manifold.

evidence_limits: The sixth repeated module and reverse end are inferred, not source-confirmed.
A/B/D camera preservation is not proof of whole-image or source-geometry accuracy.
Intentional glazed apertures and reasonable overlap among separate closed components are allowed; the complete assembly is not required to be one Boolean-unioned watertight object.
Dense sampled geometric tests are not a proof of all possible intersections or production-ready mechanical construction.

source_fidelity_status.A: Significant foreground flower and near-occlusion residuals remain.
source_fidelity_status.B: Significant window-column and ceiling alignment residuals remain.
source_fidelity_status.D: Significant seat-back-top, near-occlusion and overall-depth residuals remain; these are broader than a minor camera approximation.
source_fidelity_status.interpretation: A/B/D preserved camera parameters and transparent overlay presentation do not prove source-geometry accuracy. This deliverable is a completed-space geometry version, not a precise reconstruction or the original asset.

comparison_presentation.overlay: 50% direct overlay, no perspective warp or local stretch
comparison_presentation.result: Honest comparison presentation; visible source-fit differences remain.

visual_review.status: Geometry-completion visual review: PASS. Precise source fitting: NOT ACHIEVED.
white_geometry_views: low cross-booth table and seat floor supports
visual_review.cutaway: Independent diagnostic x=0.08 half-section, with actual mesh sectioning; not used in saved complete model or source views.
findings: No visible open backfaces, unintended shell leaks or detached structural panels in these views.
Side-window and end-door glazing has modeled depth and actual geometric apertures, corroborated by aperture-specific rays.
White close-ups show continuous roof/wall returns and real floor-contact table/seat supports.
Exterior views show a finite thickness shell and both end closures, not a modeled bogie, adjacent carriage or source-confirmed exterior.
A/B/D direct overlays honestly expose substantial remaining source-fit residuals.
visual_review.presentation_limit: Denoised review images can smooth fine details; numeric tests use the actual mesh. Geometry tests do not establish pixel-level or measured real-world fidelity.
